# BBS draft fixtures

`bls12-381-sha-256/` holds the BLS12-381-SHA-256 test vectors from
draft-irtf-cfrg-bbs-signatures, copied unchanged from the ZKryptium 0.7.1 crate
(`fixture_data/fixture_data/bls12-381-sha-256/`). Only `keypair.json`,
`signature/` and `proof/` are kept; `bbs.test.ts` uses them.
